'''Sector 151''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] the politics and societies of which the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] knew nothing.

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] noted that the [[Teljkon Vagabond]] was heading in its general direction if it did not change course.<ref name="SoL" />
